title: Cluster topology displays dead broker in ISR and stalls High-Watermark progression during follower failover
summary: Cluster topology displays dead broker in ISR and stalls High-Watermark progression during follower failover
reporter: Elena Rostova (Lead Systems Engineer, Distributed Infrastructure)
environment: Production Web App / Chromium Simulation Worker
description:
During a simulated follower broker crash scenario in the distributed Kafka topology visualizer, the partition replication status corrupts. Specifically, when a non-leader follower broker is terminated, the partition detail panel continues showing the dead broker as an active In-Sync Replica (ISR), and subsequent produce message flows fail to advance the partition High-Watermark (HW).

Diagnostic Evidence & Console Logs:
[Simulation Engine] Event received: BROKER_STATUS_CHANGED -> brokerId: 'broker-2', status: 'CRASHED'
[Simulation Engine] Warning: Partition 'orders-0' ISR contains crashed broker 'broker-2' (ISR: ['broker-1', 'broker-2'])
[InvariantChecker] HIGH_WATERMARK_BOUND assertion failure: High-watermark stalled because replica 'broker-2' LEO is unresponsive.
Component: packages/simulation/src/engine/state-transitions.ts
steps: Load TheVisualizer cluster topology scenario with 3 brokers and topic 'orders' (replication factor: 2)
Inject fault event: Crash follower Broker 2 while Broker 1 is active partition leader
Observe partition inspection panel and High-Watermark offset progression
impact: Simulation engine halts during chaos testing; student and operator playbooks show incorrect replica status and stall message throughput.
